meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 为 Grok Bot 装上 claude-mem:在本机运行 worker 监听各 agent 的记录,默认由 CMEM Pro 观察员生成观察结果,任务开始时通过 MCP session_start_context 提供上下文,并把记忆写入注入文件。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem 时触发:默认是本地 worker 加 CMEM Pro 观察员,也可选 host 登录观察员或远程 cmem.ai。

say.text: 帮我在 Grok Bot 上装 claude-mem
用 --provider host 安装,让本机 Grok 登录当观察员
say.note: 走 loopback shim,需显式选择

say.text: 把 worker 换成远程 cmem.ai,并设置 MCP token

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem on Grok Bot: a local worker per agent, a CMEM Pro observer by default, MCP session_start_context at task start, and memory written into the agent's inject log file.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: default local worker with CMEM Pro observer, optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem on Grok Bot
Install with --provider host so my Grok login is the observer
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim; opt-in only

say_en.text: Point the worker at remote cmem.ai and set my MCP token
